# ADR-3205: AWS iam: Prefer permission boundaries for developer role 5

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Unbounded CreateRole enables privilege escalation.

## Decision

Platforms SHOULD prefer permission boundaries for developer role 5 (AWS-iam-5) when delegating IAM creation.

## Consequences

Boundaries cap maximum permissions.
